article.headline: Hayden Tibbits scores 17 to guide St. Thomas to 79-70 victory over Long Island University
article.description: — Hayden Tibbits’ 17 points helped St. Thomas defeat Long Island Univeresity 79-70 on Monday night.
article.linkText: Hayden Tibbits scores 17 to guide St. Thomas to 79-70 victory over Long Island University

categories.description: St. Thomas Tommies @ Long Island University Sharks

event.description: St. Thomas Tommies @ Long Island University Sharks

keywords: St. Thomas Tommies @ Long Island University Sharks
article.story: NEW YORK -- — Hayden Tibbits’ 17 points helped St. Thomas defeat Long Island Univeresity 79-70 on Monday night. Tibbits added five rebounds for the Tommies (3-3). Jeremy Lorenz added 15 points while going 6 of 11 and 3 of 5 from the free-throw line, adding five rebounds and three steals. Brogan Madson had 13 points and shot 4 of 10 from the field and 5 for 7 from the line. Justin Johnson led the Sharks (0-6) in scoring, finishing with 20 points. LIU also got 18 points and seven assists from Daquan Davis. Josh Pickett had 12 points, nine rebounds and two steals. Up next for St. Thomas is a matchup Thursday with Southeast Missouri State at home. LIU hosts UNC Wilmington on Wednesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
